decision_conditions: Enlargement of a dwelling house (Class A) - The operations comprising a single storey rear extension would consist of the enlargement of a dwelling house within the meaning of Class A of Part 1 of Schedule 2 to the Town & Country Planning (General Permitted Development)  (England) Order 2015 "the Order" and would comply with the development tolerances set out in said Class A. The operation would therefore have been granted planning permission by Article 3 of the Order.

Enlargement of a dwelling house (Class B) - The operations comprising a rear dormer and hip to gable would consist of the enlargement of a dwelling house within the meaning of Class B of Part 1 of Schedule 2 to the Town & Country Planning (General Permitted Development)  (England) Order 2015 "the Order" and would comply with the development tolerances set out in said Class B. The operation would therefore have been granted planning permission by Article 3 of the Order.

Alteration to the roof of the dwelling house (Class C) - The operations comprising x3 rooflights to the front roof slope would consist of any other alteration to the roof of the dwelling house within the meaning of Class C of Part 1 of Schedule 2 to the Town & Country Planning (General Permitted Development)  (England) Order 2015 "the Order" and would comply with the development tolerances set out in said Class C. The operation would therefore have been granted planning permission by Article 3 of the Order.
description:
APPLICATION FOR A LAWFUL DEVELOPMENT CERTIFICATE IN RESPECT
OF THE PROPOSED ERECTION OF A SINGLE-STOREY REAR EXTENSION, CONSTRUCTION OF A
REAR DORMER AND HIP TO GABLE, INSTALLATION OF A x3 ROOF LIGHTS TO THE FRONT
ROOF SLOPE
